subtitle: Smiling Coast Massage
nameMeaning: The name Nafa comes from Mandinka, one of the principal languages of The Gambia. It means that which does good, that which nourishes, that which benefits.
story: Nafa Wellness was founded by Aminata Sama Corr, a CRMTA-certified massage therapist based in Edmonton, Alberta. She brings professional, personalized massage therapy directly to your home, office, or hotel — no commute, no waiting room, just your appointment, on your schedule, with her full attention.
mission: Professional, certified massage therapy, brought to the comfort of your own space, with genuine care and attention to what you need.
positioning: Nafa Wellness is a mobile massage therapy service based in Edmonton, Alberta. Aminata Sama Corr, a CRMTA-certified massage therapist, brings personalized care directly to your home, office, or hotel.
